reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering summer crops, fish, mushrooms, prepared foods, Slime eggs, refined minerals, rhubarb products, rice, and rice shoots were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established fish and mineral names, crop timing, Slime terminology, food context, object gender, water-adjacent growth, harvesting instructions, and gameplay wording; both found no remaining objective issue.

RedCabbageSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 9 days to mature.
RedCabbageSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le vara. Ajung la maturitate în 9 zile.

RedMullet_Description.source: Long ago these were kept as pets.
RedMullet_Description.translation: Cu mult timp în urmă, acești pești erau ținuți ca animale de companie.

RedMushroom_Description.source: A spotted mushroom sometimes found in caves.
RedMushroom_Description.translation: O ciupercă pătată, întâlnită uneori în peșteri.

RedSlimeEgg_Description.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
RedSlimeEgg_Description.translation: Poate ecloza într-un Incubator de Slime.

RedSnapper_Description.source: A popular fish with a nice red color.
RedSnapper_Description.translation: Un pește popular, de o frumoasă culoare roșie.

RefinedQuartz_Description.source: A more pure form of quartz.
RefinedQuartz_Description.translation: O formă mai pură de cuarț.

Rhubarb_Description.source: The stalks are extremely tart, but make a great dessert when sweetened.
Rhubarb_Description.translation: Tulpinile sunt extrem de acre, dar, odată îndulcite, sunt grozave în deserturi.

RhubarbSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 13 days to mature.
RhubarbSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le primăvara. Ajung la maturitate în 13 zile.

Rice_Description.source: A basic grain often served under vegetables.
Rice_Description.translation: O cereală de bază, peste care se servesc adesea legume.

RicePudding_Description.source: It's creamy, sweet, and fun to eat.
RicePudding_Description.translation: Este cremoasă, dulce și plăcută la gust.

RiceShoot_Description.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 8 days to mature. Grows faster if planted near a body of water. Harvest with the scythe.
RiceShoot_Description.translation: Plantează-i primăvara. Ajung la maturitate în 8 zile. Cresc mai repede dacă sunt plantați lângă o întindere de apă. Recoltează-i cu coasa.
